newsitem.title: USA: Intraday CSCE world sugar barely up, holds support.
newsitem.headline: Intraday CSCE world sugar barely up, holds support.

text.p: CSCE world sugar prices were trading slightly higher in light, midsession dealings, with the spot March contract maintaining support at 10.35 cents, traders said.
But as the market attempted a consolidation following Monday's losses, follow-through speculative liquidation around the highs at 10.40 cents in March, capped the move higher.
While light trade buying on a scale-down basis supported the March contract at 10.34 cents, the buying dried up at the highs, a dealer said.
"And with the physical market so quiet, I wouldn't be surprised to find new selling," he added.
Resistance was seen at a gap on the charts between Friday's low of 10.50 cents, and Monday's high of 10.47 cents, basis March.
Major support was seen at 10.20 cents in March. The trader noted reluctance on the part of the speculators to go short at that level, which would take some pressure off the downward slide.
At 1128 EST, March was up 0.03 to 10.38, after trading 10.41 to 10.34 cents. The back months were unchanged.
Volume at 1100 EST was estimated at 7,164 lots.
